book.name: 1 KOLINTI
book.title: Kolinti wewenasida luhuwa namba 1 Polokaho je biye

content: Jisesida wewenala yuhasida ehada li nupa itae loko lo biye.
Ito Jelusalemu numutoka Jisesida wewenalale yuhasida ehada litae liki li nupa itabo ga maya olotiya lo libituyo, elilo. Galaisiya ebakuka minoko monoka wewenasida lo bobomidana iki lolo ilo.

Edimoya ehada likaka niaboya moli eliki Omaimidana holi onawalau yupeka Sadeuya ona moliki edimotipoya li yawalo yawalo iki li maloka mola mola iki minalo. Sakiya li nupa amideko nemokahoya omutoko woko hetokoyoko alikaya ehada li nupa itabokumu opa-napa ikatayo.
Edimotoka wokoyoko wewena mako dilipi eto iminatabo wewenasida maya luhuwa nesa bekoko doli hekoyoko, ehada li nupa iminatabototi liki Jelusalemu numutokaya witayo.
Ito nemokiya magoina wetune liki lideko maya nemokiya magoinaya wetuniyo. 1 Lom 15:25-26
Poloma minabotoka wekolo onawa molaiye.
Nemoya Masedoniya ebakuka wekolo noboya, yaloka woko onawa lasolasi minokoko aku edimo minabotoka wekoloe.
Edimotoka woko onawa lasolasi mino-loko noyowoyoko ho lamibo onawa maya suwetibo nehe. Ito anulokatiya nilimitaboya ayaloka wetuwe.
Sa-onenako, nemoya olotiya aha anu moloko nowoko edimoda mudaidomo wetuboya wehe lamekolaiye. Sa-oneyoko edimotoka woko onawa minawasima minokoko wetuwe loko noloe, We napatemamo elidekoya.

Malokaya We napamamo monoka yowanu litubomidana anuwa maya wileko le soto molonimikaiyoko yowanu lekaka noyoko woko wehe lokaka noibo ne. Ito monokamidana ulalalo weya mukiya minanako, nemoya Epesisi numutoka minoyoko Omaimidana weuna oluhola limibo holi maya niseko wekolaiye.
Timoti maya nemoya obo nesa leko We napamidana yowanula lekaka noinako, edimo minabotoka wetibo maya wati iki gahena li mideko upalo elamoko elowa jeko netiye.
Sa-etibo neyo, ohatama we maya ne liki mesaha jitamilo. Nemoki iwenele malokakiya aya wemuya ujapa oko minudawo nenako, anuloka okepa nomoladeko maya moli huka huka amideko nemo minobotoka nisitiye.

Ito iwete Apoloda gala maya letuyo. Lemo iwetele malokakiya Apolo maya edimotoka wetiye loko upalo ga loko oli hudawo maya neboya, olotiya le lolowa oko minamiye. Sa-okainako, wetibo anula maya golotonedeko maya edimo minabotoka yaitaya wekolaiye. 5 Apo 19:21 9 Apo 19:8-10 10 1 Kol 4:17
Polo maya dupamu elekoko luhuwa jeko suwiye.
Edimoya ujapa iki monoka elekaka nesalo makoko elewole ilo. Sakiya oli libamideko dabuha moliki minalo.
Sainahena mako lolo ikili maya omutiki dukaya Omailoka molikiki alikaya wewenaloka molikiya lolo ilo.

Sa-onenako, wewenanele yuhase, ga mako lo libituyo, elilo. Edimoya Stepanasida menakipa oluholalesidamuya sa-liki likaka niae: Akaiya ebatokaya omutiki monoka eliki duka li wili jebo maya ne. Ito monoka wewenasiya edimotoka elekele yowanu leko minatune liki data elikiki liki minikaka niae.
Sa-oneboya, edimoya yamidana wewenaki ito lilimi wati iki monoka yowanu liki miluma elikaka niabo wewena malokakiya li damaitoka molalo.
Ito edimoya Kolinti wewenalitamuya miluma eleko minobotoka Stepanasile Potunatakile Akaiyokoyakileya nemotoka nisikayoko dukauya yowoe.
Sa-ikayoko edimoki nemokiya emo okepau mudaiyoko emo okepau mudaiyoko okudanaki muluteu dowa liye. Sa-okaiyoko edimokiya asaiki yamidana wemuya elideko dowa lideyo.

Esiya ebakuka monoka elebo wewenasiya dupamuya delokaiyoko noloe. Ito we Akuilate menala Pilisilatesida numudanipou li esa iki monoka likaka niabo wewenasiya We napamuya eliki edimo dupamu delokaiyoko elekoko noloe.
Muki maloka minabo wewenaya Jisesida wewenalaleya dupamuya delokaiyoko noloe. Yane ahonele unamotakuse, edimoya monokamuya liki dapusa jiki minalo.
Nemo Polo maya olotiya luhuwa jekaka noibo we kusikusimidana adelauti luhuwa jekaka noibo oijo maya lekodanaki milumatipo elekoko luhuwa maya jeko nosuwoe.
Ito wewena mako We napamidana muluna obohala mametibo wewenamidana maya Omailimo hulo hekaloka moloetadeko jomidana oluhola lolo etiye. We napate yamale emoya nisowo.
We napate Jisesida nasahilila maya edimotoka mino moloko minadeyo.
Nukaneya Kalaesti Jisesidamuye loko edimotoka maya minokaka noiye. 15 1 Kol 1:16 19 Apo 18:2
